required: Current graph, obligation ledger and invalidation state
conditional: New candidate validation evidence generated during Phase 9

steps.action: Mechanically prefill and verify the concise evidence index
steps.instruction: Prefill exact identities, milestone references/digests, candidate/finding IDs, obligation statuses, remediation state and Full-only omission rows from canonical controller/evidence state wherever available. reviewer-4 verifies the machine-known facts and adds only decision-relevant context; do not retype/reconstruct known identifiers.

Using the mechanically populated index and canonical ledgers, verify that every material candidate, finding and due retained obligation has a final disposition; author the residual-risk/limitation conclusions and explicitly enumerate all Full-only omissions.

steps.action: Issue and seal the Lite final report
steps.instruction: State scope, methods, evidence, findings, remediation status, limitations, Lite verdict and no-repeat Full upgrade route; seal the combined Phase 8-10 milestone.

sealingCriteria: Every material candidate/finding has a final disposition
Every due retained Lite obligation is closed or disclosed
All Full-only omissions and residual risks are explicit
Evidence index and Lite final report are sealed
No claim of Full assurance is made

recoveryRoutes.route: Return only to the affected Lite segment or record the exact limitation
Reopen affected Phase-8 validation and Phase 9 only if remediation follows
Use LITE_TO_FULL_UPGRADE.md and the standard Full Phase 6/7 path
